new_findings_this_cycle.description: sklearn wrapper applying isotonic/sigmoid post-fit calibration to any tree model. Directly wraps XGB/ET/RF. Expected -0.002 to -0.005 Brier improvement from probability calibration alone.
new_findings_this_cycle.implementation: Wrap predict_proba output in CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=5) during island eval. CPU-compatible, no new data needed. Only S22 has Venn-Abers now — others are uncalibrated.

new_findings_this_cycle.description: Mamba state-space model processes sequential game stats, Feature Imitating Networks for latent signal representations. Captures temporal dynamics beyond rolling windows. Better than LSTM on sequential NBA data.
